answers.sql: SELECT station AS "역", SUM(board) AS "승차 인원" FROM subway_daily WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY station ORDER BY "승차 인원" DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: 같은 역 이름은 노선과 관계없이 station으로 묶어 합산

answers.sql: SELECT AVG(alight) AS "평일 하루 평균 하차 인원" FROM subway_daily WHERE year = 2024 AND line = '2호선' AND station = '강남' AND day_type = '평일'
assumptions: 하루 평균은 해당 날짜들의 alight 평균

answers.sql: SELECT month(date) AS "월", SUM(rides) AS "대여 건수" FROM bike_city_hourly WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY month(date) ORDER BY "월"
assumptions: 대여 건수는 bike_city_hourly.rides 합계(대여 시작 기준)

answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "비 온 날 수" FROM weather_daily WHERE year = 2025 AND rainy_day
assumptions: 비 온 날은 rainy_day(하루 강수량 1mm 이상)

answers.sql: SELECT date AS "날짜", temp_max AS "최고 기온" FROM weather_daily WHERE year = 2024 ORDER BY temp_max DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT gu AS "구", dong AS "행정동", SUM(avg_rides_per_day) AS "하루 평균 대여 건수" FROM bike_dong_hourly WHERE quarter = '2025-Q2' AND day_type = '평일' GROUP BY adm_cd, gu, dong ORDER BY "하루 평균 대여 건수" DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: 행정동 하루 평균은 시간대별 avg_rides_per_day를 24시간 합산

answers.sql: SELECT gu AS "구", COUNT(*) AS "매장 수" FROM cafes WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2' AND brand = '메가MGC커피' GROUP BY gu ORDER BY "매장 수" DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: 매장 수는 cafes 표에서 quarter='2026-Q2' 한 분기만 세어 구별로 집계

answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "저가 커피 매장 수" FROM cafes WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2' AND tier = '저가'
SELECT gu AS "구", dong AS "행정동", delivery_days AS "배달 서비스 사용일수" FROM delivery_monthly WHERE month = DATE '2025-12-01' ORDER BY delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: 배달 값은 주문 건수가 아니라 한 달 배달앱 사용일수 평균(delivery_monthly.delivery_days)

answers.sql: SELECT gu AS "구", dong AS "행정동", single_household_ratio AS "1인 가구 비율" FROM delivery_monthly WHERE month = DATE '2025-12-01' ORDER BY single_household_ratio DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter = '2024-Q4') AS "2024-Q4 매장 수", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2') AS "2026-Q2 매장 수", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter = '2024-Q4') AS "증가 수" FROM cafes WHERE brand = '메가MGC커피' AND quarter IN ('2024-Q4', '2026-Q2')
assumptions: 각 분기 스냅샷에서 brand='메가MGC커피' 매장 수를 세어 뺌

answers.sql:
WITH d AS (SELECT date, SUM(rides) AS rides FROM bike_city_hourly WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY date)
SELECT CASE WHEN w.rainy_day THEN '비 온 날' ELSE '비 안 온 날' END AS "구분", COUNT(*) AS "날 수", AVG(d.rides) AS "하루 평균 대여 건수" FROM d JOIN weather_daily w ON d.date = w.date GROUP BY w.rainy_day ORDER BY "구분"
assumptions: 따릉이 하루 대여 건수는 날짜별 rides 합계, 비 온 날은 rainy_day(1mm 이상)
2025년 2월 17일 이후 원본 누락일은 데이터가 없어 비교에서 빠짐

answers.sql:
WITH d AS (SELECT date, weekday, SUM(board) AS board FROM subway_daily WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY date, weekday)
SELECT weekday AS "요일 번호", CASE weekday WHEN 0 THEN '월' WHEN 1 THEN '화' WHEN 2 THEN '수' WHEN 3 THEN '목' WHEN 4 THEN '금' WHEN 5 THEN '토' ELSE '일' END AS "요일", AVG(board) AS "하루 평균 승차 인원" FROM d GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday
assumptions: 하루 평균은 날짜별 서울 전체 승차 합계를 요일별로 평균

answers.sql: SELECT gu AS "구", dong AS "행정동", COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS "대여소 수" FROM bike_stations GROUP BY adm_cd, gu, dong ORDER BY "대여소 수" DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: 기간을 말하지 않아 bike_stations 전체(2024-12~2026-06 공개본 합본) 사용
대여소 수는 station_id 중복 제거 후 셈

answers.sql: SELECT AVG(temp_avg) AS "평균 기온" FROM weather_daily WHERE date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND date < DATE '2025-08-01'
assumptions: 서울 평균 기온은 2025-07 일별 temp_avg의 평균(재분석 자료)

answers.sql: SELECT SUM(board) AS "승차 인원 합계" FROM subway_daily WHERE year = 2025 AND line = '2호선'
SELECT gu AS "구", dong AS "행정동", store_count AS "상가 수" FROM stores_dong WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2' ORDER BY store_count DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT gu AS "구", dong AS "행정동", SUM(population) AS "30대 인구" FROM delivery_age_monthly WHERE month = DATE '2025-12-01' AND age IN (30, 35) GROUP BY adm_cd, gu, dong ORDER BY "30대 인구" DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "행정동 수" FROM dong WHERE gu = '마포구'
assumptions: dong 표(2024~2026에 나온 행정동 전체) 기준, 분동·개칭된 동이 함께 들어 있을 수 있음

answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT adm_cd) AS "스타벅스가 있는 행정동 수" FROM cafes WHERE quarter = '2026-Q2' AND brand = '스타벅스'
assumptions: cafes 표 quarter='2026-Q2', brand='스타벅스' 매장이 있는 adm_cd 수
